name: What-if calculator
definition: Inputs that produce an estimate such as ROI or savings.

demo.how: Adjust team size, hours saved per person each week and hourly cost; the estimate updates as you type or slide. Savings = people × hours × 46 working weeks × hourly cost. Cost = people × $25 × 12 months. Payback = cost ÷ weekly savings. All figures are illustrative; Reset restores the defaults.
